name: Asset Alchemist
compatibility: Unchanged /nexus-application-gateway/alchemist/ Discord button URL; no changes to other launchers
privacy: All sources processed locally in browser, never uploaded; resulting file saved by user or persisted in browser Pack Vault
features: Animated icon ZIPs with PNG fallbacks
known_limits: Browser must decode original video codec (typically MP4 H.264 or WebM VP8/VP9).
Animated GIF import requires Chromium ImageDecoder.
GIF output is silent, up to 8 seconds, 96 frames and maximum 512px long side.
GIF icons do not animate in Windows .ico; platform-specific animation restrictions may apply.
development_verification: Automated Node validation and GIF roundtrip; live GitHub Pages runtime requires browser testing.
